note: Betting-against-beta leg. Least correlated with low_vol of the defensive set (rank corr 0.40) and the least negative on train (t60=-1.8), so it is the least ruled-out member of the family. idio_vol is deliberately omitted: it is 0.99 rank-correlated with low_vol and would be a duplicate test.
